about_the_game:
Welcome to the one and only place for Carbon City's retro and nostalgic fans the cabaret stage Atomic Age. A futuristic, humorous, slapstick based point & click adventure in the shape of the 50th and 60th years. The mysterious death of William, the former owner of the small stage, still casts a shadow over Carbon City. Fortunately, an old family friend, Hector, immediately takes over the daily operations and sets new accents with a grand opening show. A perfect opportunity for actor Edward to launch his big breakthrough. A turbulent adventure, divided into three acts, begins. Will Edward and his friends manage to unravel the mysteries behind Atomic Age and protect William’s legacy?

  • Interact with objects, characters, and locations by clicking on them

  • Collect and manage items that can be used to solve puzzles

  • Optional hint system to give the player a next possible suggestion

  • Extended language support German and English

  • A compelling narrative game play, filled with twists and mysteries

  • Inventory, Logic and Environment based puzzle types

  • Auto-safe system to rejoin the game without losing progress

  • Hand-drawn style with detailed backgrounds and character sprites

  • Voice acting to enhance character development and immersion

  • Jazz inspired atmospheric soundtrack

  • Animated or illustrated story scenes to advance the plot

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu LTS
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better)
  • Graphics: Intel HD 5000 / NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon R7
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo 2.1
  • Additional Notes: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0
